page_title: PSG 2-3 NIC | PSG v Nice 15/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Clement Turpin has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Nice quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+6' Evann Guessand (Nice) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
90+5' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
90+4' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
90+3' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
90+1' Nice work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Milan Skriniar (Paris SG) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
87' Pablo Rosario (Nice) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Khephren Thuram.

87' 2 - 3 A good lofted pass from Randal Kolo Muani finds Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) on the edge of the area. He collects the ball and rips in a wonderful shot which ends up inside the right post. The score is now 2:3.
83' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
83' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) receives a yellow card!
80' Substitution. Terem Moffi is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
79' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Melvin Bard and he is replaced by Romain Perraud (Nice).

79' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
77' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) is able to continue to play.
76' Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
75' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
71' Substitution. Sofiane Diop makes way for Evann Guessand (Nice).
71' Marcin Bulka (Nice) picks up a yellow card.
71' Here is a change. Morgan Sanson is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
70' Terem Moffi (Nice) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.

68' 1 - 3 Goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Gianluigi Donnarumma had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:3.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Bradley Barcola (Paris SG) comes onto the pitch so that Ousmane Dembele can be given a rest.
66' Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
64' It will be a substitution. Randal Kolo Muani (Paris SG) is ready to enter the pitch as Goncalo Ramos walks off.
63' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Manuel Ugarte (Paris SG) replaces Carlos Soler.
63' Clement Turpin shows a yellow card to Melvin Bard (Nice) for a tough tackle.
63' Khephren Thuram (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
62' Achraf Hakimi (Paris SG) tested Marcin Bulka with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
60' Sofiane Diop (Nice) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
59' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Paris SG, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Clement Turpin blows his whistle after Sofiane Diop (Nice) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Paris SG have been awarded a free kick.
59' The Paris SG players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.

56' Gianluigi Donnarumma pulls off a great save to deny Sofiane Diop (Nice) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
53' 1 - 2 Terem Moffi feeds the ball through to Gaetan Laborde (Nice), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the right side of the goal! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:2!
50' A player from Nice takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+1' The free kick is delivered by Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Carlos Soler (Paris SG) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
40' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
38' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
38' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) spurned a good chance! He gets a shot away from inside the penalty box, but it goes inches wide of the left post.
37' Goncalo Ramos (Paris SG) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
36' The free kick is taken by Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG), but ball is cleared.
35' Khephren Thuram (Nice) has tested the patience of referee Clement Turpin and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
31' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) sends the corner into the box, but Marcin Bulka intercepts it and averts the threat.

29' 1 - 1 Brilliant finish! Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Achraf Hakimi, then produced a nice strike into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:1.
29' Khephren Thuram (Nice) makes a strong challenge and Clement Turpin blows for a foul.
28' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
26' Morgan Sanson (Nice) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
26' Close! Khephren Thuram (Nice) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out.
25' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
21' 0 - 1 Goal! Terem Moffi (Nice) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Gianluigi Donnarumma. He makes it 0:1.
19' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcin Bulka, who smothers the ball.
18' Paris SG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
18' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
16' Clement Turpin has a clear sight and sees a foul from Morgan Sanson (Nice).
14' Handball by Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG).
13' A pass by Carlos Soler (Paris SG) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
12' Terem Moffi (Nice) is penalised for a foul. Clement Turpin had a clear view and blows his whistle.
11' Vitinha (Paris SG) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
8' Khephren Thuram (Nice) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
7' The ball is cleared after Terem Moffi (Nice) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' The Paris SG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
4' Vitinha (Paris SG) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
2' Kylian Mbappe (Paris SG) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
1' Ousmane Dembele (Paris SG) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Paris SG will have the kick-off.
Clement Turpin was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
